test_case.name: Option 05 Hospital Masterplan — Source-to-Rebuild Pipeline Test Case
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate and validate a production-oriented USG Input Reading pipeline that converts a source model into the smallest trustworthy tool-neutral representation needed to rebuild it in Revit or another downstream tool.
test_case.primary_goal: Reconstruct the current hospital masterplan from a SketchUp source without forcing the downstream tool to repeat the source-reading process.

excluded_from_exercise: other context not needed for this reconstruction exercise

pipeline_principles: The intake process exists to optimize production of a usable downstream outcome.
Internal reasoning steps may be extensive, but the normal production output must remain compact and tool-neutral.
Audit/conformance records are optional support artifacts, not the primary downstream payload.
Do not infer what the human has already resolved.
Use source-native structure before geometric inference.
Before interpreting complexity, search for the structure that makes the complexity redundant.
Prototype + transform + delta is preferred over repeated independent description.
A Reading Grid is a last-resort observation mechanism, not a mandatory stage.
Stop reading when the requested downstream outcome has enough verified information.
Source identity, geometric equivalence, semantic meaning, and design authority are separate axes.
Exact geometric equivalence across different source definitions does not create T1 source identity.
Grid generation must follow building/wing/structural organization, not oriented bounding boxes.

internal_reading_process.purpose: Safely interpret and reduce the source.

audit_conformance_record.purpose: Explain and prove how the interpretation was reached.

production_result.purpose: Provide the compact machine-readable representation required for reconstruction.
must_avoid: forcing downstream consumers to load the entire audit trail
inventing BIM semantics not supported by the source

optimized_pipeline.name: Define Outcome
optimized_pipeline.question: What must the downstream tool be able to reconstruct or do?
optimized_pipeline.option_05_answer: Rebuild the current hospital masterplan massing, levels, floor profiles, placements, and usable structural/reference grids.
optimized_pipeline.stop_rule: Do not read source detail that does not contribute to the requested outcome.

optimized_pipeline.name: Human Context Gate
required_inputs: current design vs existing world vs context
what content is out of scope

optimized_pipeline.name: Source Intelligence
actions: read source-native definitions, instances, groups, names, materials, layers/tags, transforms and coordinate metadata
identify source-native context and scratch/history content

optimized_pipeline.name: Active Design Isolation
optimized_pipeline.rule: Only content confirmed to participate in the requested production result enters the active reconstruction set.

optimized_pipeline.name: Architectural Organization Recognition
actions: separate semantic hierarchy from spatial observation hierarchy

optimized_pipeline.name: Repetition and Equivalence Compression
rules: T1 = same native definition identity with no relevant override
T3 = geometric/content equivalence under declared comparison scope
T4 = similarity only, non-binding until further proof
different definition ids may still have T3 match_mode=exact
exact T3 match may discharge geometric delta as proven_empty without becoming T1

optimized_pipeline.name: Need Gap Check
optimized_pipeline.question: Can the requested downstream outcome now be produced?
optimized_pipeline.if_yes: Stop intake and hand off the compact production model.
optimized_pipeline.if_no: Identify only the missing information needed for the outcome.
optimized_pipeline.reading_grid_rule: Create a Reading Grid only for unresolved areas that materially block the requested outcome.

Revit: create grids from corrected building/wing grid model
do not infer walls/rooms/facade systems unless requested
generic: load exact geometry only where needed

minimum_rebuild_steps: create one reusable 2D floor profile per prototype
switch prototype where an intentional profile change occurs
load exact envelopes only if exact outer mass geometry is required
do_not_infer: semantic building use from truncated source names unless independently confirmed

grid_generation_pipeline.failure_observation: Generating a uniform grid from each mass stack's oriented bounding box created mathematically regular but architecturally meaningless grids, especially for curved, U-shaped and branching buildings.
grid_generation_pipeline.core_rule: First understand the building, then its wings/structural zones, then determine structural rhythm, only then draw grids.

replace_old_logic.old: mass stack -> oriented bounding box -> equal regular grid
replace_old_logic.new: mass stack -> building recognition -> wing/structural-zone decomposition -> dominant axes -> grid-system classification -> healthcare module -> optimization -> validation -> Revit grid output

CUP.note: subject to equipment, vibration, maintenance, piping and structural requirements

linear_or_rectangular: detect dominant longitudinal axis from actual footprint
use repeated standard bays where possible
do not divide total length mathematically just to make all bays equal
narrow_wing: create only minimum meaningful cross-grid lines
U_or_courtyard: allow selected common datum lines where structurally meaningful
do not treat the courtyard void as a structural bay field
L_or_multiwing: create one grid domain per wing
coordinate only necessary shared lines at junction/core
branching: create one grid domain per wing
do not project every wing grid through every other wing
curved_or_crescent: use radial grids plus concentric arc grids
derive radial spacing from target arc length at a reference radius
use Revit arc grids for concentric lines
do not approximate with a large Cartesian lattice
parking: coordinate actual stalls, aisles and ramps before final column placement
CUP: do not force adjacent clinical grid through the CUP without explicit continuity decision
podium_tower: allow separate podium and tower grid domains
treat transfer structures as explicit structural-review exceptions

grid_generation_pipeline.orientation_rule: Local grids follow actual building/wing axes. Campus X/Y/Z is a common reference only.
grid_generation_pipeline.grid_extent_rule: Extend grids only enough to cross the relevant building/wing plus approximately 10-20 ft for documentation.
revit_scope_control: use building or wing scope boxes
avoid allowing unrelated building grids to dominate site views
site/campus views may hide secondary local grids
grid_generation_pipeline.acceptance_test: Would an architect or structural engineer recognize this as a plausible grid system for the building?
grid_fail_conditions: crosses multiple wings without structural reason
exists only because of a bounding box
makes the site plan visually unreadable

option_05_grid_domain_plan.B01_B02_B05_B06_B07_B08_B10: simple local linear grids after actual wing-axis recognition
option_05_grid_domain_plan.previous_261_grid_result: rejected and must not be reused

production_success_criteria: A downstream tool can rebuild the requested geometry without rereading the original source.
Repeated source geometry is represented once where proven equivalent.
The production payload is compact enough for practical downstream use.
No irrelevant context is forced into the production model.
No unsupported semantic/BIM detail is invented.
Human design authority is used where confirmed.
Grid systems are architecturally legible and structurally plausible.
Reading Grid is omitted unless unresolved information materially blocks the outcome.
failure_criteria: production consumer needs the original SKP to understand basic organization
production payload becomes an unbounded dump of internal evidence
same repeated geometry is reread/recreated unnecessarily
context/history is confused with current design
semantic meaning is promoted directly from weak/truncated source names
grid logic is driven by bounding boxes rather than building organization

next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.task: Implement building/wing decomposition before grid generation.
next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.test: B03, B09, B11 and B12 must each produce more appropriate grid-domain logic than one bounding-box grid.

next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.task: Generate corrected Revit grid records from the building/wing grid domains.
next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.test: Site view must remain legible and curved building B09 must use radial/concentric logic.

next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.task: Reconstruct the masterplan in Revit from the compact rebuild package.
next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.test: Geometry, levels, floor profiles and major mass organization match the source within declared tolerance.

next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.task: Compare rebuilt output against source and record deltas.
next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.test: Any difference is classified as source omission, adapter error, downstream-tool limitation, or accepted tolerance.

next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.task: Refine the protocol from real production failures only.
next_instructions_for_pipeline_developme.rule: Do not add more intake stages merely because they are theoretically possible; add logic only when a real downstream need proves it necessary.

governance_notes.status: test-case / pipeline-development artifact, not canonical USG protocol
